main.description: A video registered for inclusion in a consent-first dataset. Storage of the bytes is decoupled: this record only commits to a content hash and a pointer. Its consent, if any, is the org.consentvid.consent record in the same repo with the same record key.

title.description: Human-readable title, at most 300 UTF-8 bytes.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the video bytes: "sha256-" followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the video bytes, e.g. video/mp4. Readers reject values outside knownValues: it becomes the dataset's encodingFormat, which dataset loaders act on.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds: non-negative, at most 2^53-1. ATproto records have no float type.

width.description: Frame width in pixels: non-negative, at most 2^53-1.

height.description: Frame height in pixels: non-negative, at most 2^53-1.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag for the primary spoken language, if any, with a lowercase primary subtag (e.g. en, cs, pt-BR); readers reject other values.

tags.description: Topic tags, at most 32, each at most 64 UTF-8 bytes.

storageRef.description: Where the video bytes live. Readers reject refs whose value does not match the kind.

kind.description: 'url' = a public https URL; 'r2' = the public https URL of a Cloudflare R2 object; 'peertube' = an https watch/download URL on a PeerTube instance (for these three: a public host on the default port, no credentials); 'ipfs' = a CID (bafy... or Qm...), optionally ipfs://-prefixed; 'local' = an opaque contributor-side name, never dereferenced (no control characters).

value.description: Where the bytes live: a URL (url/r2/peertube), a CID (ipfs), or for 'local' an opaque contributor-side name. Never an absolute filesystem path (records are public).
